attchmntText: Vaishali Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Vaishali Pharma Limited filed a statement with the National Stock Exchange regarding the utilization of funds from the preferential issue of equity shares. The company confirms there were no deviations or variations in the use of proceeds during the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The funds were raised on 03rd July 2026 through a share swap for consideration other than cash. The total amount raised was Rs. 9,07,57,300. All funds were utilized as per the original object clause in the offer document dated 13th February 2026. The primary purpose was to part-fund the acquisition of equity shares of Kesar Pharma Limited. The statement was reviewed by the Audit Committee and taken on record by the Board on 14th November 2026. No monitoring agency was applicable.

attchmntText: Vaishali Pharma Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Vaishali Pharma Limited has approved the unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026, along with the limited review report from the statutory auditor. The board meeting took place on 14th November 2026, starting at 06:30 P.M. and concluding at 07:35 P.M. The company code is VAISHALI. The financial results and report are attached as Annexure I. The company secretary is Vishwa Mekhia.

attchmntText: Vaishali Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  Mr. Rohil Sanjay Desai and Mr. Ketur Kishor Shah as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 05, 2026.
Vaishali Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 05, 2026.
